summary: Himalaya Shipping Ltd. filed a Form 6-K press release providing a monthly commercial update for June 2026, reporting average time charter equivalent earnings of ~$52,900/day and disclosing a Board-approved cash distribution of $0.22 per share from contributed surplus. This is a routine operational and dividend disclosure with no strategic corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing does not involve a special situation.
